description: This file defines API endpoints for interacting with Confluence resources using FastAPI. It includes routes for fetching accessible resources, spaces, space details, content within spaces, and user info, leveraging ConfluenceService for data retrieval.

methods.name: get_accessible_resources( session: SessionInfo = Depends(get_confluence_session) )
methods.description: API endpoint to retrieve accessible Confluence resources for the authenticated user, restricted to OAuth users.

methods.name: get_confluence_spaces( cloud_id: Optional[str] = Query(None, description="Cloud ID for OAuth authentication"), session: SessionInfo = Depends(get_confluence_session) )
methods.description: Fetches all Confluence spaces accessible to the authenticated user, with handling for OAuth cloud_id selection.

methods.name: get_confluence_space_details( space_key: str, cloud_id: Optional[str] = Query(None, description="Cloud ID for OAuth authentication"), session: SessionInfo = Depends(get_confluence_session) )
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific Confluence space identified by space_key.

methods.name: get_space_content( space_key: str, content_type: str = Query("page", description="Content type (page, blogpost)"), cloud_id: Optional[str] = Query(None, description="Cloud ID for OAuth authentication"), session: SessionInfo = Depends(get_confluence_session) )
methods.description: Gets pages or blog posts content from a specified Confluence space.

methods.name: get_user_info( cloud_id: Optional[str] = Query(None, description="Cloud ID for OAuth authentication"), session: SessionInfo = Depends(get_confluence_session) )
methods.description: Fetches user permissions and information from Confluence for the authenticated user.
